title: Billing provider NPI label is not a claim identifier
rationale: A claim carries a billing provider identifier next to the claim number. The NPI identifies a provider (CMS, HL7 NPI), not the claim and not a patient. For the claim kind the token is not an instance. The token deliberately does not use the 10-digit NPI shape. Synthetic value: the SYNTH-P prefix marks it as fabricated, generated by the authored rule 'SYNTH-P plus six digits', not derived from any record, next to no name, date or clinical detail, and not tested against any service.

reasons: Whether an individual practitioner NPI is ever sensitive in a patient context is not source-stated.
ambiguity.wouldSettle: NPPES public-access terms and a payer-documented label vocabulary.

provenance.inference: Project inference: invalid relative to the claim kind only; non-sensitive assumes the NPI is public provider information.

title: Patient account number label whose relation to a claim id is not established
rationale: HL7 AN is an account number, a billing reference that is not the claim identifier. It is joined to a patient through other data, so identity and person linkage are open.  Synthetic value: the SYNTH-P prefix marks it as fabricated, generated by the authored rule 'SYNTH-P plus six digits', not derived from any record, next to no name, date or clinical detail, and not tested against any service.

reasons: No value format or account/claim relation is source-stated.
ambiguity.wouldSettle: A provider or payer billing specification relating account and claim references.

provenance.inference: Project inference: context-dependent because the account reference reaches a person only by a separate join.

title: Filler order number label whose relation to a prescription id is not established
rationale: HL7 PLAC and FILL are placer and filler identifiers assigned by the ordering and fulfilling systems. A filler number under a pharmacy label is an order reference; person linkage is through a separate subject, so identity is open.  Synthetic value: the SYNTH-P prefix marks it as fabricated, generated by the authored rule 'SYNTH-P plus six digits', not derived from any record, next to no name, date or clinical detail, and not tested against any service.

reasons: Neither PLAC nor FILL has a stated value format.
No NCPDP or pharmacy-standard source was read.
ambiguity.wouldSettle: A pharmacy-standard source defining prescription number and order references.

provenance.inference: Project inference: context-dependent, as for the existing order label cases.

title: Encounter visit number label whose relation to an order id is not established
rationale: HL7 VN and FHIR Encounter.identifier name an encounter reference. It links to a patient through Encounter.subject, not through the value, so it is not shown to be a prescription or order identifier.  Synthetic value: the SYNTH-P prefix marks it as fabricated, generated by the authored rule 'SYNTH-P plus six digits', not derived from any record, next to no name, date or clinical detail, and not tested against any service.

reasons: No value format is stated for visit numbers or encounter identifiers.
Whether encounter references deserve their own kind is unresolved.
ambiguity.wouldSettle: A source relating encounter and order references, or a decision to model encounter references separately.

provenance.inference: Project inference: context-dependent, same structure as the claim and order identifiers.

title: Pharmacy or facility identifier is not a prescription id
rationale: A pharmacy or facility identifier (HL7 FI, XX) names an organization or site, not a person or an order. For the prescription kind the token is not an instance. No pharmacy directory with examples was read. Synthetic value: the SYNTH-P prefix marks it as fabricated, generated by the authored rule 'SYNTH-P plus six digits', not derived from any record, next to no name, date or clinical detail, and not tested against any service.

reasons: No public facility or pharmacy identifier directory was read.
Whether a sole-proprietor pharmacy identifier is person-linked is not source-stated.
ambiguity.wouldSettle: A licensed public pharmacy or facility directory with documented label vocabulary.

provenance.inference: Project inference: invalid relative to the prescription kind only; non-sensitive assumes the organization reading.

title: Pharmacist license number is a practitioner role identifier, not a prescription id
rationale: HL7 RPH and SL are license identifiers for a practitioner. For the prescription kind the token is not an instance; whether it is sensitive is not established because it names an individual in a professional role. No provider name is involved. Synthetic value: the SYNTH-P prefix marks it as fabricated, generated by the authored rule 'SYNTH-P plus six digits', not derived from any record, next to no name, date or clinical detail, and not tested against any service.

reasons: Licence registries are often public but no registry terms were read.
Practitioner identifiers are a different role from patient identifiers.
ambiguity.wouldSettle: A state licensing registry's public-access terms and label vocabulary.

provenance.inference: Project inference: invalid relative to the prescription kind only.
